# FLX-3604: a consumers table, prefix or column names nothing the bundle has

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

tables maps each table name consumers write to an exposeId the Simulation emits, prefixes is a list of at most 64 qualifiers, and columns maps an exposeId to the column names consumers write there, each mapped to a column of that expose's contract. A name that resolves to nothing would leave a query reading a table or a column that does not exist.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3604
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
